read.thesis: Verizon guides 2026 postpaid phone net adds to 750k–1M and EPS +4–5% to $4.90–4.95, but flat wireless service revenue and elevated churn make this a volume-for-price reset, not a supply-discipline story.

capex.quote: our 2026 CapEx spending is expected to be in the range of $16 billion to $16.5 billion, a combined improvement of $4 billion from Verizon and Frontier's capital expenditures from 2025.

triggers.label: CapEx $16–16.5B, $4B below 2025 combined
triggers.quote: a combined improvement of $4 billion from Verizon and Frontier's capital expenditures from 2025

triggers.label: Postpaid phone net adds 750k–1M in 2026
triggers.quote: targeting a range of 750,000 to 1 million postpaid phone net adds in 2026
triggers.highlight: 750,000 to 1 million postpaid phone net adds

triggers.label: Wireless service revenue flat; ~180bp headwind
triggers.quote: we expect flat wireless service revenue in 2026 as we lap prior year price increases, as Dan mentioned, about 180 basis points or so of headwind

triggers.label: Adj. EPS $4.90–4.95 (+4–5%)
triggers.quote: we expect adjusted EPS to be in the range of $4.90 to $4.95 for the full year, or year-over-year growth of 4% to 5%
triggers.highlight: adjusted EPS to be in the range of $4.90 to $4.95

triggers.label: Postpaid phone churn elevated
triggers.quote: Postpaid phone churn remained elevated in the quarter, largely from prior pricing actions as well as competition

guidance.quote: targeting a range of 750,000 to 1 million postpaid phone net adds in 2026
we expect adjusted EPS to be in the range of $4.90 to $4.95 for the full year
We expect free cash flow to be $21.5 billion or more, growing approximately 7% or more
Our 2026 CapEx spending is expected to be in the range of $16 billion to $16.5 billion

guidance.metric: Mobility and broadband service revenue growth 2026
guidance.quote: We are guiding to 2% to 3% mobility and broadband service revenue growth, which equates to approximately $93 billion
We expect wireless service revenue growth to be approximately flat in 2026.
We expect to return to our target leverage range of 2.0 to 2.25x in the 2027 time frame.

guidance.value: up to $25B over 3 years, at least $3B in 2026
guidance.quote: our Board has authorized up to $25 billion of share repurchases, which we expect to complete over the next 3 years with at least $3 billion of repurchases in 2026
our goal to reach 40 million to 50 million fiber passings over the medium term
we have line of sight to delivering $5 billion of operating expense savings in 2026

red_flags.label: Network outage, brand damage
red_flags.quote: We did not meet the standard of excellence our customers expect and that we expect of ourselves.

red_flags.label: Churn elevated from price actions
red_flags.quote: Postpaid phone churn remained elevated in the quarter, largely from prior pricing actions as well as competition

red_flags.label: Leverage rises with Frontier
red_flags.quote: we expect our unsecured leverage ratio to increase by approximately 0.25x once Frontier's EBITDA contributions are factored in

evasions.quote: While we were not guiding on adjusted EBITDA, we do expect adjusted EBITDA to grow at a faster rate than adjusted EPS.
Honestly, I don't know if we need all $16 billion to $16.5 billion for our CapEx projects, but I think it's a responsible number to have there.
